title: Iran Executes Two for 'Mossad Espionage'
text:
Iran Executes Two for 'Mossad Espionage'"

" Iran executed Omid Behzad and Pouria Safvat on Aug. 3 for collaborating with Israel's Mossad. The pair were convicted of treason for transmitting sensitive intelligence—including coordinates and imagery of military and security sites—during recent regional conflicts. Behzad allegedly sent data via mobile phone to Mossad-linked channels, while Safvat, branded a "soldier of Netanyahu," was accused of sharing operational zone intelligence with the Iran International network as part of wartime cooperation with Israel."

"Mossad using the intel. targeted and killed many Iranian civilians and military personnels. This is sad that some people cant distinguish how significantly a simple piece of info can help the enemy. 😪
